verdict.rationale: Teller documents Teller Connect as an integrable, customizable connection flow (teller-docs-23). An official React hook and component supports a drop-in widget (teller-gh-1), and users can connect across 7,000+ institutions without custom institution UI (teller-docs-1, teller-docs-11, teller-docs-14). The evidence never describes creating a session server-side or receiving an access token/enrollment back from the widget, so only the widget half of the story is shown. Missing for 10: documented server-side session/init step, documented token/enrollment callback returned by the widget, hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end flow.
